symbols.name: Quaternion
symbols.description: Mutable quaternion exposed as Core.Quaternion for three-dimensional rotations. Components are scalar-first (w, x, y, z), matching GLM — not the x, y, z, w order some libraries use.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a quaternion in scalar-first w, x, y, z component order. Watch the trap: the scalar w is the first argument, unlike the x, y, z, w order used by some other libraries.

parameters.name: w
parameters.description: Initial scalar component (comes first — this is not x, y, z, w order).

functions.name: mul
functions.description: Composes this rotation with another quaternion in place.

functions.name: normalize
functions.description: Normalizes this quaternion in place; a zero quaternion becomes the identity rotation instead of NaN.

functions.name: conjugate
functions.description: Computes the conjugate without changing this quaternion.

functions.name: inverse
functions.description: Computes the inverse rotation without changing this quaternion.

functions.name: slerp
functions.description: Spherically interpolates this quaternion toward a target in place.

parameters.name: t
parameters.description: Interpolation factor; 0 keeps the current rotation and 1 reaches target.

functions.name: dot
functions.description: Computes the quaternion dot product.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Quaternion used for the dot product.

functions.name: rotateVector
functions.description: Applies this rotation to a vector without mutating either value.

functions.name: toEuler
functions.description: Converts this rotation to Euler angles in radians.

returns.description: Pitch, yaw, and roll as a Vector3.

functions.name: set
functions.description: Replaces all quaternion components in place.

functions.name: clone
functions.description: Creates an independent copy of this quaternion.

returns.description: New quaternion with the same components.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this quaternion for logging and debugging.

returns.description: Text in Quaternion(w, x, y, z) form.

functions.name: toJSON
functions.description: Converts this quaternion to a plain object for JSON.stringify.

type.name: { w: number; x: number; y: number; z: number }

functions.name: identity
functions.description: Creates the identity rotation.

functions.name: fromEuler
functions.description: Creates a rotation from Euler angles.

functions.name: fromAxisAngle
functions.description: Creates a rotation around an axis.

parameters.name: axis
parameters.description: Rotation axis; it is normalized internally.

properties.name: length
properties.description: Read-only magnitude (norm) of this quaternion; 1 for a unit rotation.

properties.name: lengthSquared
properties.description: Read-only squared magnitude, avoiding a square-root calculation.

symbols.name: Events
symbols.description: Asynchronous resource event bus exposed as Core.Events.

functions.name: on
functions.description: Registers a persistent handler in the shared event namespace.

functions.name: off
functions.description: Removes a matching handler owned by the calling resource.

parameters.name: handler
parameters.description: Resource-owned callback invoked with the emitted arguments.

functions.name: emit
functions.description: Invokes every shared handler and waits for all synchronous and asynchronous results.

symbols.name: Voice
symbols.description: Server-side proximity voice rules: how far voice carries, and who may talk to or hear whom.

functions.name: setRange
functions.description: Sets how far voice carries for talkers with no override of their own. Connected clients are told, so their playback fades out at the same distance.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Audibility radius in world units; values <= 0 restore the default of 25.

functions.name: getRange
functions.description: Reads the server-wide proximity range.

functions.name: setPlayerRange
functions.description: Overrides how far one player's voice carries, for whisper and shout modes.

parameters.name: player
parameters.description: Player whose voice carries the given distance.

parameters.name: range
parameters.description: Audibility radius in world units; values <= 0 return them to the server-wide range.

functions.name: getPlayerRange
functions.description: Reads how far a player's voice carries, with the server-wide default already resolved.

functions.name: setPlayerMuted
functions.description: Server-wide mute: a muted player's voice reaches nobody.

parameters.name: muted
parameters.description: True to stop their voice reaching anyone.

functions.name: isPlayerMuted
functions.description: Checks the server-wide mute flag.

returns.description: True when the player's voice reaches nobody.

functions.name: setPlayerDeaf
functions.description: Server-wide deafen: a deaf player receives nobody.

parameters.name: deaf
parameters.description: True to stop them receiving anyone's voice.

functions.name: isPlayerDeaf
functions.description: Checks the server-wide deafen flag.

returns.description: True when the player receives nobody's voice.

functions.name: setLocalMute
functions.description: One-way mute between two players, enforced by the server rather than the client.

parameters.name: listener
parameters.description: Player who stops hearing the target.

parameters.name: muted
parameters.description: True to mute, false to restore.

functions.name: isLocallyMuted
functions.description: Checks a one-way mute.

returns.description: True when the listener does not receive the target.

functions.name: isPlayerVoiceEnabled
functions.description: Checks whether a player left voice chat enabled in their own client settings. A preference, not a permission: use setPlayerMuted or setPlayerDeaf to enforce anything.

returns.description: True unless the player turned voice chat off.

functions.name: isPlayerTalking
functions.description: Checks whether a player is speaking right now. Tracks speech rather than the push-to-talk key: silence is dropped before it reaches the server, and the state clears shortly after the last frame. The same signal raises the playerVoiceStart and playerVoiceStop events.

returns.description: True while the player's voice is reaching the server.

symbols.name: Player
symbols.description: Framework-owned base handle for a connected player, extended by each game or mod.

constructor.name: constructor
constructor.description: Creates a wrapper for an existing connected player with this ID; it does not connect or spawn a player.

functions.name: toString
functions.description: Formats this player handle for logging and debugging.

returns.description: Text containing the player's network entity ID.

functions.name: isNametagVisible
functions.description: Checks whether this player's nametag is shown to other players.

returns.description: True unless the nametag was hidden; false also when this game has no nametags.

functions.name: isNametagHealthVisible
functions.description: Checks whether the health bar under this player's nametag is shown.

returns.description: True unless the health bar was hidden; false also when this game has no nametags.

functions.name: getNametagText
functions.description: Reads this player's nametag text override.

returns.description: The override, or an empty string when the player's own name is drawn.

functions.name: getNametagColor
functions.description: Reads this player's nametag color.

returns.description: Packed 0xAARRGGBB color; opaque white when untinted.

functions.name: kick
functions.description: Disconnects this player from the server.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Optional reason shown to the disconnected player; omitting it uses the generic kicked reason.

functions.name: emit
functions.description: Emits a named script event to this player's client connection.

parameters.name: payloadJson
parameters.description: Optional JSON payload forwarded verbatim to the owning client.

functions.name: getIP
functions.description: Returns this player's current remote network address.

returns.description: Address string, or an empty string when the player or peer is unavailable.

functions.name: setNametagVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides the name over this player's head for every other player. The health bar has its own switch, and each player can still hide all nametags locally.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: True to show this player's nametag to everyone, false to hide it.

functions.name: setNametagHealthVisible
functions.description: Shows or hides the health bar under this player's nametag, leaving the name itself alone.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: True to show the health bar under this player's name, false to hide it.

functions.name: setNametagText
functions.description: Overrides the text drawn on this player's nametag.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: Text to show instead of the player's name; empty or omitted restores the name.

functions.name: setNametagColor
functions.description: Tints the text on this player's nametag.
